title: Login button does nothing on Safari mobile
description: When tapping 'Sign in' on iOS Safari 17, the network request is never sent and no error appears.

title: Can't sign in from iPhone browser
description: Tapping the login CTA on my iPhone in Safari gives no feedback at all. Works fine on Chrome desktop.

title: Add keyboard shortcut 'c' to open New Issue modal
description: Power users should be able to press 'c' anywhere outside an input field to quickly create an issue.

title: PostgreSQL connection pool exhausted under concurrent requests
description: Running 50 parallel GET /issues requests raises QueuePool limit overflow errors after ~10 seconds.

title: API returns 500 timeout when many users load the board at once
description: Logs show SQLAlchemy QueuePool limit reached and connections timing out during load testing.

title: Export filtered issues to CSV
description: Allow downloading the currently filtered issue list as a CSV file for weekly progress reports.

title: Dark mode contrast too low on label badges
description: Yellow and cyan label pills are hard to read against the dark card background.

title: Support markdown code blocks in issue descriptions
description: Stack traces pasted into descriptions currently lose indentation and are unreadable.
